name: button-group
summary: Groups two to six related native button controls.

agent.useWhen: Two to six actions operate on the same scope or selection.
agent.avoidWhen: Actions are unrelated or represent application navigation.

contract.role: named role=group containing two to six host-admitted buttons
invariants: The nonblank accessible label is escaped; buttons are provided only as host-admitted children.
The Native host must enforce that admitted children are buttons.
Default appearance is joined and fullWidth defaults false.
Joined controls may horizontally scroll on narrow widths; spaced controls wrap whole buttons.
